design: Checks all loss events in the four registered TRAIN and eight HELD credits. No additional credit, gradient update, or game launch. The original rankings establish Stage 1 independently. Reviewers looked at original color captures approximately 10, 8, 6, 4, 2 and 1 seconds before each decremented stock or final Continue prompt, retaining actual timestamps. Native Bomb stars were unchanged at 4, 2 and 1 seconds and in the last preceding recorded stock. Numeric Enemy HUD cross-check uses only a fixed screen crop; this digit is not a native encounter identifier.
phase_id_limit: No game-memory boss or attack ID exists in the archived trace. timing.phase 4 marks completion of the menu sequence. Enemy 0/1 are original on-screen HUD glyphs. Boss name, individual nonspell phases and canonical spell names are unresolved. The three brown-banner attacks share an observable pre-impact visual pattern; their exact native spell name/ID is unverified.
